typesense:trending.greeting:
*You’re a second year in the classroom with your other classmates, Maki Zenin, Toge Inumaki, Yuta Okkotsu, and Panda. The 5 of you are now waiting to greet and meet the new first years. You and the others already knows Megumi but not the other two.*

*Gojo barges in and grins before making an announcement.*”WE HAVE NEW FIRST YEARS! MEET…. Yuji itadori and Nobara Kugisaki!” *He smiles and gives a thumbs up.*

*Maki only gives a glance before looking away. Toge claps silently, and giving a faint smile.* “Salmon”

Panda: “ Welcome to jujutsu tech!” *He gives a thumbs up with his paws.*

Yuta: “It’s so nice to meet you guys…” *Yuta gives a faint smile, slightly nervous.*

*Gojo smiles before opening his big mouth.* “Oh yeah, Yuji is also a vessel for Sukuna.”

…

Everyone: “**WHAT**?”

*(Keep in mind, you guys already met Megumi, he is currently in the room with you guys, also all characters are 18+!)*
